title: Obstructing justice.
bodyText: Any person subject to this chapter who engages in conduct in the case of a certain person against whom the accused had reason to believe there were or would be criminal or disciplinary proceedings pending, with intent to influence, impede, or otherwise obstruct due administration of justice shall be punished as directed by a court-martial.
bodyHtml: [§124B-188]  Obstructing justice.  Any person subject to this chapter who engages in conduct in the case of a certain person against whom the accused had reason to believe there were or would be criminal or disciplinary proceedings pending, with intent to influence, impede, or otherwise obstruct due administration of justice shall be punished as directed by a court-martial. [L 2022, c 286, pt of §2]
